## Current release decision (updated)

- **Purpose:** make Classic C the default on the ESP32-S3 **and** in the web AudioWorklet; keep Legacy A rollback.
- **Fixes included after initial PR creation:** WASM build identity metadata is generated in the build root and published into the served web directory only after a successful target build; 7.3 Multi-Head + Ping-Pong A/C stimulus uses the correct 3-head mask `activeHeads=7`.
- **Dependent experimental PR:** [#59 Repeat Aging C1/C2/C3](https://github.com/ovelhaaa/hydra-tape-engine/pull/59), targeting this PR's branch. **It does not change this PR's default C0.**
- **Human listening:** Classic C was musically accepted; the later C1/C2/C3 tests were all acceptable, but the user found them very similar, so no experimental candidate is promoted.
- **Current gate:** run checks on the *latest HEAD* and confirm remaining physical ESP32-S3 production/rollback verification. Previous CI/artifact links below are historical snapshots, not validation of newer commits.
- **Merge policy:** remain draft until readiness is explicitly established; no automatic merge.

---

## Objetivo: Classic C padrão **e audição web imediata**

Esta é uma revisão da Fase 7.3 para atender ao objetivo musical: **usar a arquitetura C tanto no ESP32-S3 padrão quanto na demo web com AudioWorklet**, sem aguardar outra fase para experimentar no navegador.

### Modificações

- `platformio.ini`: `esp32-s3-devkitc-1` (e `pio run` sem `-e`) agora usam Classic C; `esp32-s3-legacy-a` oferece um fallback **separado**, sem macro C=1 herdada. Mantidos aliases `esp32-s3-classic-c`/profilers.
- `CMakeLists.txt`: o target real `hydra_dsp_web` recebe `HYDRA_PHASE72_CLASSIC_FEEDBACK_ROUTING=1` por padrão. `-DHYDRA_WEB_LEGACY_A=ON` permite comparação web com A (outro diretório de build).
- `hydra-build-info.json` gerado por CMake, exibido no cabeçalho da demo: `DSP: Classic C (WASM)` ou Legacy A. Caso o arquivo esteja ausente, a UI marca como **unverified**, nunca presume C.
- `.github/workflows/web-pages.yml`: verifica `hydra-build-info.json` **e** o argumento real do compilador para `hydra_dsp_web.dir/dsp/core/tape_core.cpp`, exigindo C=1, além dos testes web e Chrome AudioWorklet.
- `.github/workflows/core-equivalence.yml`: compila e publica separadamente firmware padrão C e rollback A.
- `identity` do firmware relata `ProductionArchitecture=CLASSIC_C` ou `LEGACY_A_ROLLBACK`.
- Guia de audição imediata: [PHASE7_3_WEB_CLASSIC_C_QUICKSTART.md](https://github.com/ovelhaaa/hydra-tape-engine/blob/feat/phase7-3-classic-c-web-default/docs/PHASE7_3_WEB_CLASSIC_C_QUICKSTART.md).

### ✅ Web preview compilada e validada

O build web **PASSOU** no HEAD inicial desta PR, incluindo C=1 verificado no comando de compilação e teste do AudioWorklet no Chrome:
- [Workflow Web Demo — execução aprovada](https://github.com/ovelhaaa/hydra-tape-engine/actions/runs/45079698357)
- [Download do artifact web-demo-build](https://github.com/ovelhaaa/hydra-tape-engine/actions/runs/45079698357/artifacts/14777066201)

Os checks de firmware e demais suites da PR continuam sujeitos à aprovação separada; não confundir preview web PASS com release de produção aprovado.

### 🎧 Como ouvir na demo antes do merge

1. Aguardar o job `build` do workflow **Web Demo (Build + Deploy Pages)** desta PR.
2. Baixar artifact **web-demo-build**; extrair os arquivos.
3. Abrir terminal na pasta que contém `index.html`, executar `python -m http.server 8000`.
4. Visitar `http://localhost:8000/`, confirmar badge **DSP: Classic C (WASM)**, carregar áudio, usar **Start Audio Context**, tocar e testar feedback/Reverse/Multi-Head; exportação offline usa o mesmo WASM.

**Importante:** GitHub Pages não publica automaticamente uma URL de preview da PR. A demo pública na Pages só muda após merge na `main`; o artifact permite testar C localmente **antes** disso.

### Compatibilidade e limites

- O target da demo Web **é C**. Os executáveis Native/WASM e golden tests históricos **continuam A nesta PR**, isolados para preservar regressões anteriores; migração de todos os goldens exigirá decisão posterior.
- DSP e seus filtros não foram modificados; a seleção é por compilação.
- Hardware real, áudio de entrada I2S, fallback na placa e avaliação auditiva web exigem execução humana; CI verde não substitui estes testes.
- Sem mudanças em NVS/partições/flash automática.

### Critérios para aprovação

- [x] Web Demo no Chrome/AudioWorklet com novo WASM C e status de arquitetura correto.
- [ ] CI inteiro verde, incluindo firmware C e Legacy A.
- [ ] Escuta humana da C na web.
- [ ] Validação física do firmware padrão e do rollback ou pendência documentada.
- [ ] Aprovação explícita antes do merge.

**Não fazer merge automático.**

## Phase 7.4A — Repeat Aging (experimental, follows PR #58)

**Stack:** `main` → [#58 Classic C production/web](https://github.com/ovelhaaa/hydra-tape-engine/pull/58) → **#59 C1/C2/C3 experiments**.

### What is in scope
- **C0:** unchanged, frozen Classic Tape Feedback C baseline; documented bit-exact comparison with PR #58 at `e815117`.
- **C1:** dynamic spectral wear with neutral bypass when inactive.
- **C2:** transient-responsive softening with neutral bypass when inactive.
- **C3:** moderated combination of C1 and C2.
- No ABI/parameter changes, no automatic promotion to production ESP32-S3 firmware, no changes to the default C0 audio.
- Native tests, deterministic 48 kHz/128-sample WASM renders, spectral analysis, and a comparative Web Audio player.

### Human listening decision
**C1, C2 and C3 all approved for musical acceptability**; the user reported that they sound **very similar**. This is *not* an instruction to choose C3 or change the production default. **C0 remains the production/reference candidate.**

### Integration fixes
- Correctly based on `feat/phase7-3-classic-c-web-default` (not the obsolete `fix/phase7-2e-realtime-optimization` branch).
- Incorporated PR #58's post-build WASM metadata safety fix and corrected three-head listening scenario (`activeHeads=7`).
- Experimental CI is triggered on branch pushes to build C0–C3 and publish `hydra-phase74a-repeat-aging-listening`. [Phase 7.4A CI](https://github.com/ovelhaaa/hydra-tape-engine/actions/workflows/phase74-repeat-aging.yml).
- Validation report: `docs/phase7-4a/LISTENING_DECISION.md`; experimental architecture, spectral data, and real-time feasibility documented alongside it.

### Release gates
- [x] Correct PR dependency/base and preserve original history
- [x] Record human audition and preserve C0 as baseline
- [x] Propagate PR #58 safety and multi-head fixes
- [ ] Latest CI, including C0 comparison and 7.4A artifact, green
- [ ] Validate output artifact manifest/WAV hashes and A/B player from current HEAD
- [ ] ESP32-S3 physical timing, source transitions, and rollback verified before *any* experimental production promotion
- [ ] If #58 is merged into `main`, retarget this PR to `main` before its eventual integration

**Current policy:** experiment only; no merge, no auto-merge, and no C1/C2/C3 promotion without a separate explicit decision.

| Variant | Standard Single-Head | Multi-Head + Spring | Multi-Head + Reverse + Spring | Overruns |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|

The corrected benchmark and non-flashing config gate were added in later commits. Latest HEAD CI must be green before merge.

## Phase 7.4C — Unified Tape Motion Engine + Web UI

**Status: Draft — integration validation and human listening required.**

### Dependency / isolation

- **Base:** `feat/phase7-3-classic-c-web-default` ([PR #58](https://github.com/ovelhaaa/hydra-tape-engine/pull/58)).
- **Source/reference for experimental motion:** [PR #60](https://github.com/ovelhaaa/hydra-tape-engine/pull/60) (M0–M3).
- **Independent from Repeat Aging:** [PR #59](https://github.com/ovelhaaa/hydra-tape-engine/pull/59) is deliberately **not** incorporated.
- M0 / Classic C remains the default. **No production promotion, auto-merge, or firmware flash authorized by this PR.**

### Implementation

- Single C++ `TapeMotionEngine` selectable in real time: **M0 Classic, M1 Motor Drift, M2 Capstan Flutter, M3 Worn Transport**.
- ~150 ms modulation-displacement crossfade; delay history, feedback, Multi-Head, Reverse, and Spring are kept alive during changes.
- Additive C DSP parameter IDs **38–46**: `motionMode`, `motionAmount`, `stereoMotion`, `motionInertia`, `motionDriftChar`, `motionTexture`, `motionIrregularity`, `motionInstability`, `motionTensionRec`; unchanged legacy IDs.
- Single WASM/AudioWorklet implementation with discrete motion-mode commands, real L/R displacement telemetry, continuous controls, and offline WAV export.
- Web UI: mode selector, common motion controls, per-mode Advanced parameters, and live motion meter.
- Additive V2 preset support with V1/V2 import compatibility, native/web/Playwright test sources, ESP32-S3 experimental environment and physical benchmark scripts.

### Validation / acceptance gates

- [ ] **Current PR HEAD CI green**, including Native/WASM, web tests, browser and ESP32-S3 build (do not count historical/local test reports as this PR's CI).
- [ ] Explicit **M0 bit-exact** against frozen Classic C reference with identical compiler flags and deterministic inputs; document any caveat.
- [ ] Recheck M1/M2/M3 audio parity against the approved Phase 7.4B variants, and verify rapid mode switches / high-feedback stability.
- [ ] Browser UI: check actual computed visibility of Advanced panels (not only the `hidden` property), keyboard interaction, responsive layout, and real DSP parameter updates.
- [ ] Verify old/new preset roundtrip and offline WAV export uses selected mode.
- [ ] Publish a **7.4C audition artifact** with WAVs, variant-identifying manifest/hashes, transition render, and straightforward playback instructions.
- [ ] **Physical performance evidence audit:** published report cites COM15 benchmark; independently confirm effective production flags, firmware SHA, raw serial logs, no overruns, and comparisons on the same configuration. Physical run remains unqualified if evidence is missing.
- [ ] Resolve documentation discrepancies: `REALTIME_FEASIBILITY.md` includes physical results but `LISTENING_ACCEPTANCE.md` still marks physical sign-off pending.
- [ ] Correct the web header still stating **“34 Parameters Mapped”**.
- [ ] Human listening of the **unified** engine and transitions. The user liked M1/M2/M3 from the separate 7.4B builds; that is **not** yet 7.4C acceptance.

### Documentation

See `docs/phase7-4c/` for architecture, runtime switching, parameter contract, web UI, preset migration, real-time feasibility, and listening acceptance.

### Merge policy

**Keep this PR in Draft; do not merge or deploy experimental motion to production** until the checks and auditory/physical acceptance gates are explicitly cleared. When #58 merges to `main`, recheck the diff and retarget this PR appropriately.

body:
## Behavior
The historical texture blend attenuates the direct instrument and mixes a short tape head into its attacks. This experiment adds optional CLASSIC / STUDIO policies to the real Hydra Web UI and DSP. Classic remains default and preserves the frozen sound. Studio restores unity dry after wet processing, excludes the short texture tap from monitoring, and adds a 0–200% Wet Level outside feedback. Switching morphs over 30 ms without resetting the one tape engine or changing Motion Mode.

API 1.9 appends IDs 47/48; all old IDs, C structures and symbols remain. New presets store the controls. Legacy web imports and built-in firmware presets restore Classic. The real UI confirms the C-API target and switches without recreating AudioWorklet/WASM.

## Dependency
Stacked draft, dependent on #61 at c1f996b. Its inherited Web Demo / Unified Motion reset-control failure was fixed separately in c1f996b; the stabilized base and current experimental HEAD have successful checks. Phase 6 Listening Lab passes. No merge, promotion, flash, or changes to #58/#59/#60.

## Validation at 565ae35
- All current GitHub checks successful; Pages deploy skipped as expected for this draft.
- Native 22/22 and WASM 22/22 CTest PASS, including Classic C, legacy goldens/ABI consumer, MIDI Clock and Tap Tempo.
- Frozen M0 and M1/M2/M3 comparisons bit-exact; 32 further Classic scenes byte-identical to stabilized #61.
- 132 source/level/rate calibrations: zero numerical dry error with wet muted at 44.1/48 kHz, −24 through −0.01 dBFS. Signed zero can change; no general bit-exact Studio dry claim.
- 45 real-WASM web tests, live UI/AudioWorklet Playwright, old-preset restore, mobile layout and no-node-recreation checks PASS. The synchronized blind A/B player also passes browser tests.
- Ten identical-input Studio Native/WASM renders match locally; CI reruns the comparison with explicit tolerance and exactness reporting.
- Native CI benchmark: Classic 0.019866 vs Studio 0.020239 ms/128 frames (~1.9% incremental in that run), against 2.6667 ms at 48 kHz. Raw Native/WASM runs are included in the artifact.
- Standard and experimental ESP32-S3 compile PASS. Local final experimental build: static RAM 27,152 bytes, flash 649,927 bytes; compiler/platform differences explain differing CI size reports. No physical timing claim.

## Published listening package
[Download hydra-phase75a1-studio-signal-path-listening](https://github.com/ovelhaaa/hydra-tape-engine/actions/runs/45263172793/artifacts/14861902617)

Contains ten synthetic instrument A/B scenarios, synchronized/blind player, real Web UI + WASM, float WAVs, THD/phase/spectral/mono/tail/headroom metrics, hashes, manifest and Windows instructions. Outputs are not independently normalized. Sources are synthetic approximations, not human listening evidence. Artifact is built from 565ae355b75741ee8aca37fc6c09c0aac449bf8b.

## Review boundaries
The separate full-scale guard hard-limits overload instead of dynamically normalizing or compressing nominal dry. Sample peaks are bounded, but intersample peaks can exceed full scale. Shared Spring/Smear memory morphs excitation rather than duplicating complete output chains; audition its tails. Physical incremental ESP32 CPU/deadline measurement remains for a separately authorized hardware phase.

Unity is specified at TapeCore/C API/Worklet boundaries. The firmware I2S block path already skips external tanhf when TapeCore ran; optional host gate/Freeverb and masterVolume × 0.90 remain outside that contract. The legacy MP3 ConsumeSample path still has external tanhf. No analog or whole-firmware unity claim is made.

Audit, architecture, gain/headroom, parity, feasibility and listening guide: docs/phase7-5a/.

**HUMAN_LISTENING_PENDING — Classic stays default.** Next: blind comparison using real guitar recordings, then shared-auxiliary-tail review and a separately authorized physical benchmark before any promotion.

Historical evidence remains intact: 10/10 WAV hashes; seven reconstructed musical/silence inputs; seven historical/probe PCM payloads differ beyond existing tolerances, so container metadata alone is not the cause. Reset, explicit commit and block64 differential tests do not recover the representative guitar output. Exact cause remains undetermined; three impulse recipes remain HISTORICAL_RECIPE_UNKNOWN. F0.2 defines new impulses without claiming historical recovery.

Validation on clean builds from source 3cc6c1b plus only these docs/scripts: Native CTest 19/19 in the default environment without #63; three Native goldens bit-exact; WASM goldens 3/3; existing five-scenario Native/WASM comparison max_abs=0/RMSE=0 with original 1e-5/1e-6 limits; input/LUT 4096/1025 bit-exact; full-engine 27/27 with six 60-second tails. Baseline verification also rejects deliberate PCM corruption in a separate copy.

Review: docs/evidence/dsp-reform-f0-2/README.md, REPRODUCTION_PROTOCOL.md, baseline_manifest.json, diagnostic_comparison.json and validation.json.
